name: web_search
description: Search the web for current information, facts, or anything not already known. Pass a concise, well-formed search query - not the user's full raw sentence verbatim.

query.description: A short, focused search query (a few keywords or a clear question) - not the user's entire message verbatim. E.g. for 'can you search for the best song on the web', use 'best song 2026' or similar, not the full sentence.

max_results.description: How many results to return. Defaults to 5 if omitted.
